strings.display.title: Display
strings.display.readable_note: Your phone’s own font for text, menus and buttons. Large sizes turn it on.
strings.display.motion_os: On already, because your phone asks for less motion.
strings.display.red_note: Dim red on black, so your eyes stay used to the dark.
strings.display.language_note: Draft translations. Place names stay in English; for rules, the linked official source counts.
strings.i18n.facts_note: Rules and regulations are draft translations. The official source linked with each one is the version that counts.
strings.glance.title: Tonight at a glance
strings.glance.share_note: Share tonight’s wind, weather, sunset and what’s biting
strings.log.backup: Back up or move your trips
strings.pg.home_lead: Live levels, tonight’s bite, ramps and the rules after dark for Ohio waters. Pick yours and it opens first next time.
strings.pg.stamp_lt: Level and temp live from the {src} gauge, updated {ago}
strings.pg.stamp_l: Level live from the {src} gauge, updated {ago}
strings.pg.hub_lead: Personal, unofficial {lake} hub in Ohio: species pages, water maps, trip log, and gear kits.
strings.pg.live_pool: Live {src} refresh updated pool (provisional). No public water temp gauge on this lake.
strings.pg.rule_thumb: A rule of thumb guide, not a promise.
strings.pg.log_lead: Trip cards from the waters. Your own trips are saved on this phone only.
strings.pg.no_account: No account needed. Build an email, or open a GitHub issue.
strings.pg.sp_lead: Filter the grid, then open a species card for season · where · limits · gear · bait.
strings.pg.app_lead: Add The Night Bite to your home screen. It opens full screen with the lantern icon, and the pages you’ve opened still work with no signal.
strings.pg.app_note: On newer iOS, Chrome’s Share menu has it too.
strings.pg.unofficial: Unofficial summary. Posted signs and the agencies above have the final word.
strings.pg.water_lead_b: : maps, depth structure, pool vs the ODNR chart, and public ramps. Not a navigation chart.
strings.pg.rule_note: Draft translation. Check the linked official source for the exact wording.
strings.pg.qf_pool_map: Summer pool is {n} ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
strings.pg.qf_pool_contour: Summer pool is {n} ft, the level the ODNR contour map is drawn at.
strings.pg.qf_pool_city: Full pool is the City dam crest, {n} ft. ODNR fishing map depths are based on {m} ft.
strings.pg.qf_park_hours: State park hours are {h}; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.
strings.pg.qf_city_hours: City park hours are {h}; check posted signs before a night trip.
strings.pg.qf_city_night: 10 mph from sunset to sunrise (City code). City park hours are {h}; check posted signs before a night trip.
strings.pg.qf_docks_city: The city lists the marina dock season as May 1 to Oct. 31, so the marina docks are done for 2026. No date posted yet for pulling the ramp docks.
strings.pg.qf_docks_hoover: Public boat dock rentals run May 1 to Oct. 31, so the rental season is closed. Whether the marina docks and the public launch courtesy docks are in the water is unconfirmed. City alerts and ODNR do not confirm they are in or out. An open ramp does not mean a dock is installed.
strings.pg.qf_motors_hoover: 10 hp limit and 10 mph; idle speed within 100 ft of shore. Boats 22 ft max.
strings.pg.qf_ramps_hoover: Five public ramps: Oxbow Road, Sunbury Road, Twin Bridges, Red Bank and Walnut Street. Shore access on the Mudflats Boardwalk.
strings.pg.qf_motors_city: Unlimited horsepower; 40 mph by day. Idle speed within 100 ft of shore and bridges. Boats 22 ft or shorter, no personal watercraft.
strings.pg.qf_ramps_osh: Home Road ramp and marina, and the Bellepoint ramp. Canoe and kayak launches at Twin Lakes and on the east side.
strings.pg.qf_no_gauge: No public gauge, so this site shows no live level.
strings.pg.qf_tip: Unofficial summary. Posted signs and the agencies above have the final word.
strings.pg.qf_motors_alum: Unlimited horsepower on the south main lake, no wake on the north end. The state park puts the line at US 36/SR 37, the Corps at Cheshire Road, so follow the buoys.
strings.pg.qf_ramps_alum: Four public launch ramps: New Galena, the marina ramp on Hollenback Road, Cheshire and Howard. One more for campers.
strings.pg.qf_pool_normal: Normal summer pool is {n} ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
strings.pg.qf_mwcd_night: MWCD areas close from 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. except to people fishing, hunting or boating.
strings.pg.qf_ramps_griggs: Griggs boat launch south of Fishinger Road, plus the marina and public boat docks.
strings.pg.qf_electric: Electric motors only, at no wake speed.
strings.pg.storm_now: Thunderstorms possible now. Get off the water at first thunder.
strings.pg.storm_now_alert: Thunderstorms possible now. See the alert up top. Get off the water at first thunder.
strings.pg.storm_after: Thunderstorms possible after {time}. Get off the water at first thunder.
strings.pg.storm_after_alert: Thunderstorms possible after {time}. See the alert up top. Get off the water at first thunder.
strings.pg.stamp_lt_off: Offline. Level and temp last updated {ago}
strings.pg.stamp_lt_fail: Live refresh failed. Level and temp last updated {ago}
strings.pg.stamp_l_fail: Live refresh failed. Level last updated {ago}
strings.pg.cond_status: NWS hourly forecast for {lake}, barometer from {station} at {t1}. Checked {t2} ET.
strings.pg.cond_status_nob: NWS hourly forecast for {lake}, barometer from {station}. Checked {t2} ET.
strings.pg.sp_count_1: {a} of {b} species on this site live at {lake}. 1 is this month’s pick, tagged Biting now and listed first.
strings.pg.sp_count_n: {a} of {b} species on this site live at {lake}. {n} are this month’s picks, tagged Biting now and listed first.
strings.pg.sp_count_0: {a} of {b} species on this site live at {lake}.
strings.pg.sp_away_intro: No ODNR survey, stocking record or fishing area page lists these at {lake}. Their pages read as notes for the lakes where they live.
strings.pg.typical: {when}. Typical pattern, not a fishing report.
strings.pg.not_pick: At {lake}, but not one of this month’s picks.
strings.pg.bt_thunder: Tonight: thunder in the forecast, so Tough.
strings.pg.bt_nothunder: Tonight: no thunder in the forecast.
strings.pg.bt_norating: Tonight: no rating yet. It needs the barometer trend or tonight's wind.
strings.chip.mwcd: Closed 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. except fishing (MWCD)
strings.chip.no_parking: No parking dark to dawn outside camping areas (City code)
strings.chip.odnr_11: Park hours end 11 p.m., fishing allowed after (ODNR)
strings.chip.odnr_sunset: Park hours end at sunset, fishing allowed after (ODNR)
strings.chip.strouds: Strouds Run hours end 11 p.m., fishing allowed after (ODNR)
strings.pg.no_trips_lake: No community trips at {lake} yet. Log one and send it in.
strings.pg.fill_first: Fill required fields first, then show markdown.
strings.pg.no_geo_lakes: This browser can't share a location, so lakes stay grouped by region.
strings.pg.nearest_first: Nearest first, straight line miles. Your location stays on this device.
strings.pg.no_problem: No problem. The steps above still work any time.
strings.pg.loc_off: Location off, sorted from the lake.
strings.pg.sorted_you: Sorted from your location. It stays on this device.
strings.pg.shops_fail: Shop list didn't load. Try again when you have signal.
strings.pg.no_gauges: No public lake level or water temp gauge on this lake. Never invented.
strings.pg.notif_off: Notifications are off for this site, so use the calendar option instead.
strings.pg.log_unavail: Log unavailable right now. Open the log for your own trips.
strings.pg.no_backup: No trips saved on this phone yet, so there's nothing to back up.
strings.pg.too_big: That file is too big to be a Night Bite backup.
strings.pg.no_match: Nothing matches “{q}”. Try the water’s name or a nearby town, like Mt. Sterling.
strings.pg.pool_aria_up: Pool level over the last 7 days: {w}, up {a}, from {f} to {l}.
strings.pg.pool_aria_down: Pool level over the last 7 days: {w}, down {a}, from {f} to {l}.
strings.pg.snap_prov_notemp: Provisional snapshot; your browser may refresh it from {src}. No public water temp gauge on this lake. Never invented.
strings.pg.live_pool_out: Live {src} refresh updated pool (provisional). USACE outflow temp updated; it is not lake surface temperature.
strings.pg.live_pool_prof: Live {src} refresh updated pool (provisional). No live water temp; the Corps posts a temperature profile.
strings.pg.snap_prov_out: Provisional snapshot; your browser may refresh it from {src}. USACE outflow temp; it is not lake surface temperature. Never invented.
strings.pg.snap_prov_prof: Provisional snapshot; your browser may refresh it from {src}. No live water temp; the Corps posts a temperature profile. Never invented.
strings.pg.snap_t_out: USACE outflow temp, not lake surface
strings.pg.snap_prov: Provisional snapshot; your browser may refresh it from {src}. Never invented.
strings.pg.rem_today_app: Reminder set for today at {t} on this phone. It is scheduled with the app, so it can go off while the app is closed.
strings.pg.rem_tom_app: Reminder set for tomorrow at {t} on this phone. It is scheduled with the app, so it can go off while the app is closed.
strings.pg.rem_today_open: Reminder set for today at {t} on this phone. It goes off only while The Night Bite is open. For a sure thing, add it to your calendar too.
strings.pg.rem_tom_open: Reminder set for tomorrow at {t} on this phone. It goes off only while The Night Bite is open. For a sure thing, add it to your calendar too.
strings.pg.cal_today: Calendar file saved. Open it to add the reminder today at {t}.
strings.pg.cal_tom: Calendar file saved. Open it to add the reminder tomorrow at {t}.
strings.pg.inst_title: Keep The Night Bite on your phone
strings.pg.inst_body: Opens like an app, and the pages you've visited still open at the lake without signal.
strings.pg.inst_ios: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Pages you've visited still open without signal.
strings.pg.inst_aria: Add The Night Bite to your home screen
strings.pg.installed: Installed. Open The Night Bite from your home screen.
strings.pg.pool_aria0: Pool level over the last 7 days
strings.pg.log_clear_note: Clear removes only the trips saved on this phone. Save a backup first if you want to keep them.
strings.pg.demo_entry: Demo entry, not a live bite report
strings.pg.log_empty_lake: No {lake} trips saved on this phone yet. All lakes shows your other trips.
strings.pg.log_empty: No trips saved on this phone yet. Add your first one below.
strings.pg.log_backup_note: Save a backup file, then open it on a new phone or browser. Trips in the file are added to the ones here; nothing is replaced.
strings.pg.log_share_note: Public ramp and area names only. No secret GPS, no private property. Text notes only, no photos. Sent trips wait for review and only go up once they’re approved.
